headline: Tesla to End Cybertruck Production in 2027 to Focus on Cybercab
summary: Tesla will halt production of its electric trucks in mid-2027 to increase output of its autonomous ride-share vehicle, according to CEO Elon Musk.
why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle manufacturer, and shifts in its product roadmap and capital allocation directly affect its market position and valuation.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Major product line cancellation and shift toward autonomous ride-sharing impacts future revenue streams.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A major strategic shift away from an announced flagship product toward autonomous vehicles alters expectations for Tesla's future product lineup and capital expenditure.
